h:
我想分享一个 ComfyUi 简单的工作流程，这是我在 A1111 上花费的时间与 Hires、Loras、多个细节设计师和最后一个升级器 + 风格过滤器选择器一起重现的。我用它快速、轻松地生成 16/9 4k 照片。

对于 ComfyUi 的初学者，请从 Manager 扩展开始这里并安装缺少的自定义节点应该可以正常工作；）

我用我的模型对于图像。

检测和升级模型可以在 Zip 文件夹中找到。

对于更详细的图像和更高级的 WF，我建议您看一下这里.

o.en:
I wanted to share a ComfyUi simple workflow i reproduce from my hours spend on A1111 with a Hires, Loras, Multiple detailers and a last upscaler + a style filter selector. I use it to gen 16/9 4k photo fast and easy.

For beginners on ComfyUi, start with Manager extension fromhereand install missing Custom nodes should works fine ;)

I used mymodelfor images.

Detection and Upscaler models can be found in Zip folders.

For more detailed images and a more advanced WF, I recommend you take a lookhere.
